needs.text: FEWS NET expects 18 to 19 million people to need food help at the peak, January to March 2027.

register.text: The 2026 monsoon gave 19% less rain than normal nationally. Sindh was 51% below normal and Balochistan 34% below; Punjab was close to normal (4% below).
The water regulator (IRSA) planned for 22% less canal water than usual for Punjab and Sindh this winter-crop season; its first estimate was 26%.
The Afghan border has been closed to trade since October 2025, and FEWS NET expects this to continue through May 2027. It cuts work and income in border districts.
Wheat imports have restarted (about 51,000 tonnes reached Karachi in late October) and Sindh cut its official wheat release price from Rs5,000 to Rs4,500 per 40 kg on 4 November.
DAP fertiliser rose from Rs14,009 to Rs17,183 a bag (50 kg), 23% more, at wheat-sowing time.
Estimates of the last wheat harvest disagree: Federal Committee on Agriculture 29.3 million tonnes, USDA 29.0, Dawn (October) around 27.5, flour-trade estimate about 26. Dawn puts the need at 31.9.
FEWS NET expects 18 to 19 million people to need food help at the peak, January to March 2027.
Winter rain is forecast average to above average (above average in KP and Gilgit-Baltistan in December and January), which would help rain-fed wheat.
About 2.7 million children under five in 45 districts were acutely malnourished or expected to be (October 2025 to September 2026), 706,000 of them severely.

actions.title: Check the 8 Alert-level districts on the ground
actions.text: Mostly in Sindh and Punjab. Confirm hunger, prices and stocks with district officials before money or food moves.
actions.owner: PDMAs with provincial food departments, WFP and FAO

actions.title: Act on flour prices and the cash that buys flour
actions.text: Price pressure is highest in Sindh. Review wheat release prices and volumes and import arrivals, and check that BISP payments still cover basic food.
actions.owner: Provincial food departments, Ministry of National Food Security, BISP

actions.title: Prepare food, cash and nutrition support for 80 districts expected in Crisis
actions.text: FEWS NET expects the greatest need from January to March 2027. Place stocks before snow closes mountain roads and start child-nutrition screening.

actions.title: Protect the wheat crop from the canal-water shortage
actions.text: Canal water for Punjab and Sindh is planned 22% below normal. Publish rotation plans early and favour wheat at its water-critical stages.
actions.owner: IRSA, provincial irrigation and agriculture departments
